question: Find the area of the sector of a circle with diameter 14 cm, if the arc of the sector makes an angle of 120° at the centre of the circle. (Use pi = frac {22} {7} )
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the circle = 14 cm

Radius (r) = 7 cm

Angle of the sector = 120º

**Formula used:**

Area of sector = (theta)/(360) times pi r²

Where, θ = angle of the sector

**Calculation:**

Area of sector = (120)/(360) times (22)/(7) times 7 times 7

⇒ Area of sector = (1)/(3) times (22)/(7) times 49

⇒ Area of sector = (22 times 49)/(21)

⇒ Area of sector = (1078)/(21)

⇒ Area of sector = 51 frac {1} {3} cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
